skills.name: Flamme Destinee
lines: Fire type magic attack on a single enemy x3 (XL)
* Based on Card Drawn: [ Blue ] \ [ Red ] \ [ Green ] \ [ White ]
** Critical rate and Magic critical rate of all party members +70% \ 80% \ 90% \ 100% (1 move)
** Fire type attack of all party members +35% \ 40% \ 45% \ 50% (3 turns)
** Restore all statuses (occurs after damage calculation)
** Skill multiplier is Card based. W>G>R>B
** Skill multiplier is LCK based: (approx. formula from tests)
***For White card: = (1 + (luck/3) + (luck3 / 240000) (rounded down to nearest integer)) x 3
**** Сap doesn't exist.
* Refer to Flamme Destinee page for possible multipliers and req. equipment

abilities.name: Heal - Fire Stance - Fire
lines: When in Raging Fire Stance:
* Restore all party members' HP +10% \ 20% \ 30% \ 40%
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Fire type moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
** Counting Rules - in-length explanations
* Equipment and some effects multiply healing.
